info.name: ZWA Protocol Phase 3 — rooted lineage API
info.description: Pinned regtest fixture API validation. Public v3 evidence only. Demo mode and configured A7 view required.

exec: pm.test("Pinned verifier identity and policy", () => { pm.expect(body.relation).to.eql("NormalLineageStepV2"); pm.expect(body.verifierId).to.eql("lineage-v2-l1"); pm.expect(body.vkDigest).to.match(/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/); pm.expect(body.parameterIdentity).to.match(/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/); pm.expect(body.finality.k).to.eql(3); pm.expect(body.snapshot.id).to.eql("A7"); pm.expect(body.containerVersions).to.include(3); pm.expect(body.trustSource).to.eql("PINNED_REGTEST_FIXTURE"); });
pm.test("Eligibility and settlement are not executed", () => { pm.expect(result.eligibility).to.eql("NOT_EVALUATED"); pm.expect(result.settlement).to.eql("NOT_EXECUTED"); });

function inspect(value) { if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.forEach(inspect); if (value && typeof value === "object") { Object.keys(value).forEach(key => { pm.expect(forbidden.has(key.toLowerCase()), key).to.be.false; inspect(value[key]); }); } }
